description: We propose to remove the existing conservatory at the rear of the property and construct a new single-storey rear extension. The proposed extension will be larger than the conservatory it replaces, with external dimensions of 5 metres in depth and 4.9 metres in width. The extension will not reuse the conservatory's existing base. New foundations will be laid in accordance with current Building Regulations. The floor level of the extension will be raised to match the internal floor level of the house, providing a continuous and accessible layout throughout the ground floor. Internally, the wall separating the existing kitchen and conservatory will be removed, and an RSJ beam will be installed to provide structural support, creating an open-plan kitchen and dining area. The extension will feature a flat roof with a skylight to increase natural light. A glazed door will be installed on one side to provide access to the rear garden, and a window will be positioned at the rear. Surface and foul water drainage will connect to the existing systems on site, and all works will comply with current building and drainage regulations. No new vehicular access, changes to the street layout, or additional hard-standing are proposed. The submitted plans show the precise siting and external dimensions of the extension, including the position of the proposed door, window, and skylight.
